text:
elena: FYI - onboarding for NovaCloud sent a large batch of 'test' usage events this morning that got through our pipeline and are showing up as billable in the pre-billing rollup. Can we stop the next daily run from charging these?

raj: Ugh — do we have sample event IDs / partner timestamps? Need to scope impact + whether it hit committed customers.

kevin: sample event snippet below, sent at 08:12 UTC. Looks like partner used a free-form flag 'mode=test' in metadata but our ingestion rule only looked for header X-Test.

```
{"event_id":"ev_20260323_001","partner_id":"nova","customer_id":"c_4123","units":1200,"metadata":{"mode":"test","note":"automation-run"}}
{"event_id":"ev_20260323_002","partner_id":"nova","customer_id":"c_9987","units":300,"metadata":{}}
```

kevin: so ~2100 units total across 220 events. A few map to paid customers. The issue: our partner adapters normalize headers inconsistently. Nova sent mode=test inside payload.

sophie: Support already has two tickets from customers seeing unexpected mini charges on dev accounts. If daily billing executes we need immediate credits + partner comms.

metering-bot: daily-billing-job scheduled in 3h 15m for region us-west-1 :warning:

jen: Can we gate at the pre-ingest layer for partner:nova to drop events where metadata.mode=="test"? Quick patch is possible; longer term we should normalize partner test flags during onboarding.

kevin: I can push a temporary rule to edge-ingest that excludes events where partner_id=="nova" AND metadata.mode=="test". Deploy steps (edge-safe):

```
# apply temporary filter
curl -X POST https://edge.internal/ingest/rules \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $INGEST_ADMIN\" \\
  -d '{\"partner_id\":\"nova\",\"filter\":\"metadata.mode==\\\"test\\\"\",\"action\":\"drop\",\"ttl_secs\":86400}'
```

kevin: will monitor once live. Shouldn't affect production flows.

raj: Assuming that blocks future ingestion, we still have to reconcile already-ingested events. Finance needs a list of affected customers + units. Can you produce a CSV with event_id, customer_id, units, timestamp? Also need to know which events made it into the billing rollup snapshot.

kevin: I'll export the raw events and mark which were included in the rollup. ETA 30m.

raj: Good. I'll draft a credits policy: auto-credit for any dev/test-tagged events in the last 48h for Nova partner accounts. Manual review for anything older.

sophie: I'll prepare the support template and a proactive outbound message for Nova's partner PM. Also will ask affected customers whether they want an immediate credit or a delayed invoice adjustment.

elena: Partner PM says their CI runs occasionally toggle test flags. They thought 'mode=test' would be filtered. This is on us to align. We need a short onboarding checklist item: canonical test flag field + integration test harness.

jen: Follow-up action items: 1) Kevin deploys temporary filter (now) 2) Kevin exports affected events (30m) 3) Raj prepares credit policy + amount calc (1h) 4) Sophie sends customer comms + partner PM note (30m) 5) Finance to approve credits (2h window).

kevin: pushing rule in 2m, will report back when active.

metering-bot: rule-deploy-event: rule_id=r_20260323_nova_test_drop status=queued

kevin: rule active. confirmed 0 events ingested with metadata.mode=="test" in last 5m.

elena: Thanks. Let's keep this thread for decisions. After credits are posted we should add onboarding gate to require a sample test-event run and verify we drop it in staging.

sophie: noted — will include verification step in partner checklist.

raj: Once Kevin's CSV is ready tag me and finance@redwood. I'll hold off automated billing run exception until we confirm rollup state.

elena: Status check in 45m. :thumbsup:
